== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ベイダーの目</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-277o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ベイダーが特定の位置カードで単独で戦闘を防衛している時に使う。戦闘力を＋１し、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。２：その他の能力値＞２の帝国軍が特定の位置カード上で、単独で戦闘を防衛している場合に、戦闘運命数を１回加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">装甲マスクと生命維持システムで完全防備のダース・ベイダーは、そのダーク・ジェダイの技とあいまって、決闘や戦闘では脅威的な防御力を発揮する。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Vader's Eye.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use when Vader is defending alone at a site. You may add 1 to power and add one battle destiny. 2. If another Imperial with ability greater than 2 is defending alone at a site, you may add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Darth Vader's armored mask and life support protect him fully. Combined with his Dark Jedi skills, they give him formidable defenses in duels and battles.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
